title: Prenatal Visit Schedule
definition: Low-risk pregnancies are seen monthly, then biweekly, then weekly — tracking growth, blood pressure, and fetal well-being. Each visit screens for preeclampsia and growth issues. The schedule intensifies as stakes rise.
patient_flow: Well-woman visits anchor lifelong care — Pap smears, breast exams, contraception. Prenatal patients follow a visit schedule intensifying toward delivery, with ultrasounds at key milestones. Surgical patients move through consult, pre-op, minimally invasive procedures, and recovery. Menopause and urogynecology clinics serve the later decades with equal attention.
code_demo:
def prenatal_schedule(weeks_gest):
    """Visit cadence by gestational age (low-risk)."""
    if weeks_gest < 28: return "Every 4 weeks"
    if weeks_gest < 36: return "Every 2 weeks"
    if weeks_gest < 41: return "Weekly"
    return "Twice weekly (post-term surveillance)"
print("28 weeks:", prenatal_schedule(28), "| 38 weeks:", prenatal_schedule(38))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
